channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Venezuela grants U.S.-backed oil firm NABEP 100-year concessions for 17 oil fields, White House says
item.description: Venezuelan interim authorities have granted North American Blue Energy Partners 100-year concessions for 17 oil fields, White House says.

item.title: Tanker struck in Hormuz, raising worries over escalation, as Trump vows to hit Iran 'hard'
item.description: Iran launched an attack on two American bases in Jordan on Monday in retaliation for the U.S. attack on its Larak Island.

item.title: These emerging markets are favored to get 'a wall of money' from carry trades
item.description: Emerging markets could attract more capital as Treasury bond buyback plans weaken the dollar and support carry trades, analysts say.

item.title: Bessent reportedly tells Russia no economic relief until Ukraine war ends as Europe snubs Moscow at G20
item.description: The meeting underscored Washington's willingness to reopen diplomatic talks with Moscow, as Europe intends to isolate the nation while the war continues.

item.title: Indian PM Modi implores Putin to end Ukraine war amid U.S. tariff threat on Russian oil
item.description: Indian PM Narendra Modi has urged Russia to end the Ukraine war and to cease hostilities.

item.title: Supreme Court lets Trump build White House ballroom as lawsuit continues
item.description: Chief Justice John Roberts dissented with three liberal justices, saying, "That construction is likely unlawful."

item.title: The $3 trillion oil market has just gotten more accessible than ever: No longer a 'rich man's game'
item.description: Oil trading is becoming more accessible to individual investors as smaller futures contracts, ETFs and online brokerages lower longtime barriers to the market.

item.title: Fast-fashion giant Shein's shares drop 9% in Hong Kong market debut
item.description: Shein made its Hong Kong market debut on Tuesday after years of attempts to go public.

item.title: Waiting for homebuying to get more affordable? Here's what to expect in 2027
item.description: Mortgage rates aren't expected to get much cheaper for homebuyers in 2027, especially if inflation stays high.

item.title: August was the month of the comeback kids. Cramer reviews what drove the biggest winners
item.description: CNBC's Jim Cramer said August was a comeback month for stocks that had been battered by bearish narratives.

item.title: Mortgage rates surge to the highest since June 2025 as new Middle East attacks push oil prices up
item.description: The expectation had been for falling rates this year, but the war with Iran and its resulting rise in oil prices upended that.

item.title: When someone talks down to you, use Dolly Parton's simple trick to 'maintain your dignity and disarm' them, says expert
item.description: Communication expert Dorie Clark calls it the "label upgrade" strategy. "It's a powerful move," she says. "Own the truth," then redefine their label. Here's how.

item.title: CNBC's The China Connection newsletter: McKinsey's contrarian economic view
item.description: In many ways it seems that the party has ended for many U.S. and European corporations that once enjoyed a big advantage in China.

item.title: India’s economy expands 7.8% in fiscal first quarter, beating estimates
item.description: The economy was driven by a strong performance in the financial, real estate, information technology and professional services sectors.

item.title: Trump strikes new drug pricing deals with nine midsized drugmakers
item.description: The string of deals builds on the Trump administration's push to link the nation's drug prices to cheaper ones abroad.

item.title: Manhattan's luxury rental market is booming, with units reaching $100,000 a month
item.description: New York City brokers said they've seen a surge in the number of wealthy renters, which is driving Manhattan rents to new records.

item.title: House Intelligence Committee warns of 'Black Swan' AI risks
item.description: Bipartisan lawmakers cautioned that existing safeguards may not be enough to keep up with AI's advances.

item.title: Trump says U.S. growth could hit 20%. It’s happened only once since WWII
item.description: Trump argued rapid growth should not prompt Fed rate hikes, even as inflation remains above the central bank’s 2% target.

item.title: Trump Account holders may receive $250 Dell grant starting Monday, Dell Foundation says
item.description: Eligible children with Trump Accounts will start receiving the $250 Dell gift this week, according to the Dell Foundation.

item.title: Markets see Warsh endorsing a rate hike in September. Not everyone is convinced
item.description: The path toward the move still looks cluttered.

item.title: Bessent pushes back on Druckenmiller critique of bond intervention
item.description: Bessent, at a G20 finance meeting, told CNBC he spoke with Stanley Druckenmiller after his critical op-ed was published and that their conversation went "fine."

item.title: Trump warns 'we're going to hit them hard' after Iran targets U.S. forces in Jordan: Report
item.description: The latest attacks prompted oil prices to climb above $90 a barrel, as energy market participants monitored the prospect of renewed supply risks.

item.title: FTC sues Amazon, accusing the e-commerce giant of misleading advertisers
item.description: The FTC sued Amazon, alleging the company misled advertisers through a deceptive auctioning system.

item.title: Microsoft Outlook and OpenAI's ChatGPT Work are experiencing user outages
item.description: OpenAI's ChatGPT Work offering was down for some users on Monday, and Microsoft said it was having issues with Exchange Online.

item.title: Risk-reward outlook for stocks is getting worse as historically tough month kicks off, says Citadel Securities
item.description: The risk-reward of buying protection in the equity market looks compelling.

item.title: Trump says U.S. communities opposing AI data centers could end up 'backwards and poor'
item.description: "China could not be happier with this anti Data Center movement," Trump said as Republicans express concerns about the backlash to data centers.

item.title: American Airlines announces Trump Accounts matching program
item.description: To help fund Trump Accounts, American Airlines said it will match the federal $1,000 contribution for employees' children.

item.title: Broadcom reports earnings this week. Mike Khouw says this trade could be a winner
item.description: "The stakes are high" heading into Broadcom earnings, says Mike Khouw.

item.title: Kalshi permanently bans former GOP Rep. George Santos over illegal trading
item.description: Former GOP Rep. George Santos, of New York, has drawn fire for allegedly trading on whether he would attend this year's State of the Union address.

item.title: OpenAI's ad business shows blistering growth, hits $1 billion annualized revenue run rate
item.description: OpenAI's move to serve ads in ChatGPT earlier this year drew ridicule from its chief rival, Anthropic, in the form of a Super Bowl commercial.
